guide.greenlantern.supergirl.title: Supergirl
guide.greenlantern.supergirl:
§6Argo Pendant§r
Craft the §6Argo Pendant§r and right-click it or press §eG§r to put on Supergirl's suit. She is Superman's cousin: quicker off the mark in the air, but she takes hits less well.

§6Solar Energy§r
The pendant stores sunlight. Under the open sky by day it recharges fast; in the shade and at night, slowly; underground, in the Nether and in the End, not at all. Every punch that lands gives a little back. Powers, flight and the barrel roll spend it.

§6Flight§r
Double tap jump to take off. She breaks the sound barrier in one second, faster than Superman, and lands with a hero landing. While flying, double tap §eA§r or §eD§r for a §6Barrel Roll§r: a sideways spin that makes arrows and other projectiles miss for half a second.
guide.greenlantern.supergirl_powers:
§6Heat Bolts§r: Instead of Superman's steady beam, her eyes fire quick heat bolts, one per click, that burst on the target and light fires without breaking blocks.
§6Meteor Dash§r: She launches herself in a straight line like a comet for 12 blocks, on the ground or in the air, ramming and flinging everything in the way.
§6Thunder Clap§r: She claps her hands and sends a shockwave in a cone that stuns enemies, snuffs torches and shatters glass.
§6Frost Wall§r: A freezing breath that freezes water, puts out fire and raises a wall of ice in front of her, which melts on its own after 30 seconds.
§6Super Hearing§r: While on, shows sound ripples around every creature within 40 blocks (even behind walls) and arrows on the HUD pointing to footsteps. Unlike Superman's X-ray, it shows no ores. Costs per second.
§6Kryptonian Throw§r: Grabs the creature or loose block in sight, lifts it overhead and hurls it far on the next use.
§6Solar Flare§r: Unleashes all her energy at once in a burst of light around her, stronger the more energy is left. Afterwards she has no powers or flight for 20 seconds while she recharges.
guide.greenlantern.controls_supergirl:
§eRight-click§r (Argo Pendant): put on the suit or use the power.
§eG§r: put on / take off the suit.
§eDouble tap jump§r: take off / stop flying.
§eW§r while flying: speed up. §eCtrl§r: speed up faster.
§eA A§r or §eD D§r while flying: Barrel Roll (dodge). §eS§r: air brake.
§eR§r (hold / tap): power menu / next power.
§eV§r: use the selected power.
§eShift + right-click§r (pendant): whistle for Krypto.
§eEmpty hand on Krypto§r: sit / follow.

guide.greenlantern.krypto.title: Krypto the Superdog
guide.greenlantern.krypto:
The first time she puts on the suit, §6Krypto§r dives down from the sky in his little red cape and stays with her.

§6Companion§r
He follows Supergirl on foot or flies beside her, bites whoever attacks her or whoever she attacks, fires heat vision now and then and brings loose items he finds to her feet. He never attacks players, villagers or tamed animals.

§6Commands§r
Right-click him with an empty hand to make him sit or follow again. Name him with a name tag. Bones heal him. Crouch and use the pendant to §6whistle§r: he comes from wherever he is.

§6Hurt§r
If his health runs out he does not die: he flies off to rest and comes back after a minute. The pendant keeps his name and health.
